discard_pending.description: After a reboot, accept the read-back values and drop the pending marker.

oneOf.description: Applies overclocking on the rig and keeps it for re-application after reboot.
Restores driver defaults and forgets the saved overclock.

releases.description:
Official Linux builds offered in the flight sheet, newest first. Empty for adapters
that only run a custom download URL.

core_state.description: CORE_STATE: DPM state to set and pin, 0 = auto.

mvdd.description: MVDD, mV (PowerPlay table; accepted for HiveOS import, not written in this release).

pl.description: PL: power limit in W, 0 = driver default.

ref.description: REF: memory refresh via amdmemtweak when it is installed on the rig.

soc_clk.description: SOCCLK, MHz (PowerPlay table; not written in this release).

soc_vdd_max.description: SOCVDDMAX, mV (PowerPlay table; not written in this release).

vddci.description: VDDCI, mV (PowerPlay table; not written in this release).

config.description: Pool URLs (`urls`, first is primary), wallet template, password, algorithm, extra args.

miner.description:
Like HiveOS: which miner and where the rig downloads it from. `adapter`, `name`,
`version`, `url`, optional `sha256`, `executable` (native adapters). Rigs fetch the
package themselves; the controller never stores or forwards it.

GpuOcConfig.description:
Overclocking in HiveOS's own terms (`nvidia-oc.conf` / `amd-oc.conf`). Every list holds one
value per card of that vendor in PCI bus order; a shorter list repeats its last value, so a
single value applies to all cards, and an empty list leaves the setting untouched.

MachineBatchInput.description: Batch onboarding: every row carries its own verified host key; credentials are usually shared.

bootstrap.description: Queue one "deploy runtime" job for every machine that was created.

MachineBatchInput.title: MachineBatchInput

bootstrap_error.description: The machines were created, but queueing the runtime deployment failed.

sudo_password.description: Optional privilege password. Omitted on edit to retain the saved value.

MessageDismiss.description: One line of the HiveOS-style per-machine message feed: runtime events, job results and audit.

key.description: `source:id` of one message; omit to clear every chip for the machine.

MessageDismiss.title: MessageDismiss

executable.description: Path inside the archive (after its single top-level directory is stripped).

clock.description: CLOCK: core offset in MHz; a value above 500 is a locked core clock.

mem.description: MEM: memory offset in MHz, Linux/HiveOS scale (twice the Windows Afterburner value).

plimit.description: PLIMIT: power limit in W, 0 = driver default.

running_delay.description: RUNNING_DELAY: seconds to wait after boot before re-applying, like HiveOS.

SshProbeBatch.description: Up to 256 endpoints whose SSH host keys are fetched in parallel for one review screen.
SshProbeBatch.title: SshProbeBatch
